# NiyuktiPoints

> Official educational resource and technical recruitment update portal for Polytechnic Diploma Engineering (BTEUP) and Junior Engineer (SSC JE, UPPCL JE, RRB JE) aspirants.

## Core Offerings
- **BTEUP Study Material:** Branch-wise and semester-wise syllabus PDFs, handwritten notes, and previous year question papers (Electrical, Mechanical, Civil, CS).
- **Technical Mock Tests:** Subject-wise MCQ practice sets for diploma semester exams and JE CBT preparation.
- **Official Notice Board:** Verified alerts on polytechnic exam schedules, scholarship notices, and technical government job notifications.

## Contact & Verification
- **Portal URL:** https://niyuktipoints.vercel.app/
- **Support Email:** kp.team.support@gmail.com
